atoms.name: natural_pred

atoms.name: is_zero

operators.name: △₉₆
operators.definition: a △₉₆ b = { (♣₈ 1) △₇₉ 5, if a >= 6 and b < 10; (b ◇₈₄) ♥₅₁ a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 6 and b < 10, apply ♣₈ to 1, then apply △₇₉ to the result and 5; otherwise apply ◇₈₄ to b, then apply ♥₅₁ to the result and a.

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ☆₉₇
operators.definition: a ☆₉₇ b = { (☆₇₇ b) ★₅₀ (b ♧₆₆), if a >= 6 and b >= 7 and b < 11; b △₂₃ (♥₈₈ b), if a >= 6 and b >= 11; (b ↓) ☆₂₁ (b ♠₁₂), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 6 and b ≥ 7 and b < 11, apply ☆₇₇ to b, then apply ★₅₀ to the result and (b ♧₆₆); otherwise if a ≥ 6 and b ≥ 11, apply △₂₃ to b and (♥₈₈ b); otherwise subtract one from b, stopping at zero, then apply ☆₂₁ to the result and (b ♠₁₂).

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♢₉₈
operators.definition: a ♢₉₈ = { a △₉₆ (a ♤₈₇), if a >= 3 and a < 9; □₉₄ 5, else }
operators.plain: If 3 ≤ a < 9, apply △₉₆ to a and (a ♤₈₇); otherwise apply □₉₄ to 5.

operators.name: ▲₉₉
operators.definition: ▲₉₉ a = { ♡₉₃ a, if a >= 1 and a < 5; ▽₁₁ a, else }
operators.plain: If 1 ≤ a < 5, apply ♡₉₃ to a; otherwise apply ▽₁₁ to a.

operators.name: △₁₀₀
operators.definition: △₁₀₀ a = { (★₅ a) ♠₈₉ (□₉₁ 5), if a < 1; a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1, apply ★₅ to a, then apply ♠₈₉ to the result and (□₉₁ 5); otherwise return a.
